title: PqWaveformRawHeader
description: Hub -> orchestrator, published on <root>/scada/wave/<zone>/<bank_id>/<hub_id>/raw, QoS 1, triggered only (06-service-profiles-and-power-quality.md S6.4a-b). This schema covers only the structured header; per S6.4a the payload is binary (not base64-in-JSON, which would add ~33% overhead) -- a small header matching this shape, followed by the raw sample block as int16 per-channel arrays in the fixed `channels` order at `sample_rate_hz`, for `cycles` cycles, optionally delta+generic compressed per `compression`. `samples` is included here only for validating the equivalent JSON representation used in tests/fixtures (04-mvp-s-test-plan.md TS-15a/TS-15b); it is never sent as JSON on the wire.

ts.description: Capture start time, PTP/GPS-disciplined reference, sub-millisecond precision.

channels.description: 2 channels (V,I) for a 1P hub, 4 (V_A,V_B,I_A,I_B) for SPLIT_PHASE, 6 (V_A,V_B,V_C,I_A,I_B,I_C) for 3P, per phase_connection.

samples.description: Test/fixture-only JSON representation: channel name -> array of int16 sample values (cycles * sample_rate_hz / 60 samples per channel). Absent on the real binary wire payload.
